messages:
Alex: hey @Erin — quick heads up: the shared-desk rotation that starts monday is going to conflict with my migraine triggers. i've been on the west window desk for months and the rotating schedule puts me by the noisy printer. can i request a stable desk assignment as an accommodation?

Jamie: +1 to supporting Alex. i saw them step out a few times last week.

Erin (People Ops): thanks for flagging this, Alex. sorry you're dealing with that. can you share whether this is a temporary thing (a few weeks) or something you expect longer term? also fyi we have a short accommodation intake — i'll DM you the form, but we can start a temporary plan now while paperwork is processed.

Alex: thanks Erin. i think it's been getting worse over the last 2 months, so i'd like a stable desk while we sort the intake. not comfortable sharing medical details in this channel.

Mike (Manager): i can pause Alex's rotation immediately. Alex, which desk number do you prefer? i can block it on the schedule.

Alex: desk 3W (floor 3, west wing) is ideal — quieter and dimmer light. ideally, i keep it through the performance cycle in 2 months and we can revisit after.

Facilities Bot: @channel Desk booking update: https://internal-booking.company/desks — you can request a desk hold using the form. Current status: desk 3W available.

Erin (People Ops): thanks Mike. plan suggested: 1) temporary desk hold on 3W for Alex (effective immediately) 2) Erin will start accommodation intake (confidential) — optional medical note if Alex wants it, we can still grant reasonable accommodation without documentation while we process 3) outline reasonable adjustments (fixed desk, optional noise-cancelling headphones, 2 remote days/wk), 4) follow-up check in in 3 weeks. does that work?

Jamie: that seems reasonable. also, if Alex wants, i can cover during oncall shifts so they don't have to switch floors on late nights.

Alex: appreciate it all. temporary hold is great. i would like the headphones offer too — if available.

Erin (People Ops): noted. i'll DM the intake form and a short checklist of accommodations. Alex, you can reply in DM with preference; no medical docs required to start the temporary hold. if you do have documentation later, we can add it to the confidential file.

Mike (Manager): i'll update the team rotation and mark Alex as exempt until 2026-05-15. Alex, lmk if you need help moving gear.

Facilities Bot: Action: desk 3W marked as "hold for Alex" by Mike (Manager) until 2026-05-15.

Erin (People Ops): closing notes: next steps for people-ops: 1) DM intake + checklist to Alex today 2) create a confidential accommodation record 3) schedule a 3-week check-in with Alex & Mike. i'll follow up via DM and calendar invite. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Alex: thank you all — really helps reduce stress. :heart:
